source_document: Sungrow String Inverter User Manual (SG110CX/SG125HV), Section 10.2 (Troubleshooting & Fault Codes)

FAULT_39.title: Isolation Fault (ISO-F)
FAULT_39.description: Ground isolation resistance of the PV array is below the safe operational threshold.
FAULT_39.oem_definition: Low Insulation Resistance (Fault 39). Inverter impedance measurement detected earth insulation resistance lower than safety standard.
potential_causes: PV array DC cable insulation mechanical damage
Water ingress in DC string combiner or module connectors
DC positive or negative conductor pinched against ground structure
FAULT_39.recommended_action: Check PV string insulation resistance to earth per Sungrow manual. Locate and eliminate ground fault on DC side.

general_field_guidance.instruction: Disconnect AC and DC power to the inverter. Ensure DC switch is in OFF position.
Inspect DC cables entering inverter gland plate and check for chafing against sharp enclosure edges.
Test positive-to-ground and negative-to-ground insulation resistance on each string with megohmmeter.
Fix isolated string, re-connect DC inputs, and verify Fault 39 auto-clears on reboot.

FAULT_15.title: Grid Overvoltage
FAULT_15.description: Grid AC voltage exceeded the upper operating threshold configured on the inverter.
FAULT_15.oem_definition: Grid Overvoltage (Fault 15). Utility grid AC voltage is consistently higher than upper trip limit.
potential_causes: Grid supply voltage elevated by utility substation tap setting
AC line resistance too high, causing voltage rise under full solar export
FAULT_15.recommended_action: Measure grid voltage. If grid voltage is normal, inspect AC wiring connections.

general_field_guidance.instruction: Check AC terminal voltage across phases using a true-RMS multimeter.
Confirm inverter resumes grid-tied operation once voltage stabilizes within range.

FAULT_37.title: Inverter Overtemperature
FAULT_37.description: Inverter internal heatsink or ambient temperature exceeded thermal safety cutoff limits.
FAULT_37.oem_definition: Excessive Ambient/Internal Temperature (Fault 37). Temperature sensor inside inverter chassis tripped over-temperature threshold.
potential_causes: Inverter cooling fan blocked or seized
Air intake/outlet vents obstructed by vegetation, bird nests, or debris
Ambient temperature exceeding 60°C in direct unshaded sunlight
FAULT_37.recommended_action: Clear air intake and exhaust vents. Verify fan operation and clean heatsink fins.

general_field_guidance.instruction: Wait for inverter to cool. Keep hands away from hot heatsink surfaces.
Clean external air filters and inspect cooling fans for dust accumulation.
Use Sungrow iSolarCloud app to read internal temperature sensor channels.
Verify cooling fan spins up and temperature drops to normal operating range.

FAULT_10.title: Grid Frequency Deviation
FAULT_10.description: Grid frequency exceeded maximum permissible frequency threshold.
FAULT_10.oem_definition: Grid Overfrequency (Fault 10). Frequency higher than grid protection limit.
potential_causes: Grid frequency fluctuation during sudden utility load loss

general_field_guidance.instruction: Verify grid frequency via utility meter or power logger.

FAULT_43.title: String Reverse Polarity
FAULT_43.description: One or more DC strings are connected with reversed positive and negative polarity.
FAULT_43.oem_definition: String Reverse Polarity (Fault 43). Inverter detected negative DC voltage on string input.
potential_causes: Improper wiring termination during module installation or cable crimping
FAULT_43.recommended_action: De-energize inverter DC disconnect immediately. Use DC voltmeter to identify and correct reversed string.

general_field_guidance.instruction: Open DC isolator under zero load conditions.
Measure Voc of each string input. Confirm positive polarity on positive lead.
Correct wiring, re-plug MC4 connector, and verify polarity before switching on DC.
